notes.title: 5/9 Optimization Update
notes.notes:
1. Level Way Point system optimization
2. Enemy AI optimization
3. Various details optimization

notes.title: Level process, dialogue optimization
notes.notes:
Thanks to the players for their suggestions in the discussion area, we will optimize the game flow and dialogue this time.

1. Optimization of the level route system
2. Fix some wrong words
3. Various detail optimizations... etc.

If you find any BUG or unreasonable place, welcome to respond to us in the discussion area ^^

notes.title: Level optimization and difficulty adjustment
notes.notes:
Thanks to the players for their suggestions in the discussion area, we have made a lot of optimizations for the game process and levels this time.

1. Optimization of the level route system
2. Keep the P point when passing the level
3. Fix some wrong words
4. Level process adjustment
5. A reward bomb will be triggered when the level is cleared
6. Various detail optimizations... etc.

notes.title: Difficulty adjustment
notes.notes:
Thanks to players' suggestions, we have lowered the difficulty of Easy and Normal difficulties.

At the same time, the firepower can be inherited to the opening of the next level

At the same time, there are a bunch of functions for fine-tuning the difficulty.

If players with low or medium difficulty still find it too difficult, please leave a message with us in the discussion area, and we will actively refer to your opinion. ^^

notes.title: Beta Test Fix II
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who assisted with the beta testing. Here are some adjustments and corrections based on your suggestions.

1. Fix the language problem of Steam connection
2. Fixed the problem that the secondary weapon might disappear after restarting the game after a failure.
3. Adjust some UI display problems.
4. Add a Discord link in the menu
5. Adjust the difficulty of character unlocking

Yes, now the character can be unlocked when the difficulty is Hard~ Are you happy~ ^^

notes.title: beta testing bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks to the players who participated in the beta test ^^

The first correction is as follows:
1. Correct the Z button to automatically slow down
2. Modify the call pause UI in the dialogue
3. Fixed that spell bombs can be used during pause
4. Add a thank you list
5. Increase the number of game tips
6. Corrected the sensitivity of Cirno
7. Corrected CG mode H mode can use the mouse to pull the excitement bar
8. Fixed some UI display errors
9. Add new achievements
